Maya (PM): Starting planning thread for 'staged-region fallback + tenant-exemptions'. Main asks: per-region canary cadence, tenant opt-out flow, session continuity when switching variants, and automatic rollback rules.

Jon (Eng): Agreed. We should keep session stickiness for any session with KV cache or >2 turns. Routing TTL change required.

Harpreet (Infra): Proposal: Shadow 12h -> micro canary 0.2% for 4h -> 2% for 8h -> 15% for 18h -> 100% over 24h. Each step requires stable p95 and 5xx for the preceding window.

Omar (SRE): Gate thresholds: pass if p95 delta < +20% and 5xx < 0.3% over window. Abort if p95 > 900ms or 5xx > 1%. On abort run 'rw rollback --region' and notify #incidents. Also limit oscillation: if rollback >2 times in 6h, auto-disable flag for that region.

Lena (Customer Ops): High-risk tenants must get opt-in prompt; default is opt-out for enterprise/private deployments. Add audit log entry whenever tenant toggle changes. Provide preview endpoint for customers to sample fallback responses.

Jon (Eng): Quality check: shadow A/B sample 0.5% and compute cosine similarity on embeddings; require mean >= 0.9. Also track a simple task-success proxy where available.

Harpreet (Infra): Config example for flag (simplified): {"flag":"regional_fallback_v2","regions":["us-west-2","eu-west-1"],"sticky_sessions":true,"shadow_hours":12}. We'll include per-tenant overrides.

Omar (SRE): Runbook snippets: capture last 30m request traces + redact PII before storing. Add command to force tenant-exempt: 'rw flag set --tenant 123 --key fallback_disabled true'.

trace-bot: Privacy check: capture pipeline will run PII-redaction; retention 30 days.

Maya (PM): Next steps: Jon and Harpreet to spec routing TTL & KV compatibility by Thu. Omar to author rollback automation. Lena to draft customer comms. Reconvene Fri 9am PT for sign-off. :thumbsup:
